title: fix(plugin-security): the position-name fold warning says the same-name grant is removed in the next major
body:
Part of #24757

Clause-②: no (a runtime warning's wording plus one added field in its log payload; no accept set, served shape, resolution result or error code moves)

This is the card's **18.x half** under the standing rule 「甲」: the existing `position_name_fold_grant` runtime warning in `plugin-security`, re-pointed as the loud half of the position-name fold's retirement. The fold itself stays. Its removal is the card's 19.0 half, and #24757 remains open for it.

## What changed

- **Text.** The warning now says three things. ① Permission set `P` is in force for holders of position `P` only because the two share a name; `P`'s definition does not name it in `permissionSets`. ② This name-based grant is deprecated and is removed in the next major version. From then on, holders of `P` do not receive set `P` unless the position's definition names it. ③ The way out: `permissionSets: ['P']` on position `P` to keep the grant, or a rename if the shared name is a coincidence. The string carries no tracker id and no version number (`check:doc-authoring`; the docblock says why).
- **Payload.** `{ event, position, permissionSet }` gains `removedIn: 'next_major'`. The three existing fields are unchanged, because a log consumer may key on them.
- **Docblocks.** `POSITION_NAME_FOLD_EVENT` and `reportNameFoldCollisions` now say this is the 18.x loud half under 「甲」 and cite the ruling records. The stale "junction table is the governed channel" wording is replaced with ADR-0131's definition `permissionSets`. The "HotCRM NOT MEASURED" boundary note is replaced with the card's measurement (5 of 12 positions at `f22dfa52`, declared by objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2200). A "When it fires" section records the cadence measured below.
- **Unchanged.** The trigger predicate, the once-per-position cadence, and every resolution result. A holder of `P` still receives set `P` in 18.x, as 要点 5 of ruling B on #13419 requires: 「任何行为差异只能表现为拒绝/告警,⛔ 永不静默改变解析结果」.

## 「甲」 reading

- **The rule** (#6015, ruling record `6292005854`), verbatim: "No conversion can carry it: 18.x ships only the loud half (a warning, an explain line, a reported event). The refusal is filed for 19.0."
- **Triage's derivation for this card** (`6292072572`), verbatim: "**18.x:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2200 (HotCRM declares `permissionSets` on its five positions), and the existing runtime warning re-pointed as the loud half. **19.0:** the retirement itself: the fold is removed, and the delegation walk, explain and the collision check follow it."
- **Ships in 18.x (this PR):** the warning text and its reported event (the structured payload with `removedIn`). The rule lists three loud-half forms; triage's derivation for this card names the warning. `explain-engine.ts` is fenced out of this claim, so no explain line changes here.
- **Ships in 18.x, in HotCRM:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2200, HotCRM's half. It declares `permissionSets` on its five same-name positions. That silences this warning for them (pinned below as the declared-pair case) and makes Setup's two panels show the binding.
- **Waits for 19.0, on this card:** deleting the position-name request in `resolvePermissionSetsForContextUnmemoized` and `dropDeactivatedFoldedSets`, and the follow-ups in the delegated walk, explain and the collision gate. That half deletes this warning together with the fold.

## Measured (PM mechanism assumptions)

Every reading below is from `origin/main` `b811c7369`, this branch's base, by source reading.

- **The warning exists as assumed.** `reportNameFoldCollisions` emits `position_name_fold_grant` through `logger.warn` with `{ event, position, permissionSet }`. It reports a pair `(position P, set P)` only when set `P` resolved, `P` is not among the explicitly requested sets (the definition's `permissionSets` and direct grants, §6b), and `P` is not a baseline name. It shipped in 17.3.0 (changeset `936aa2d` in the package CHANGELOG).
- **Assumed gap confirmed.** The old text was "This grant is in force and ungoverned: no position declares it. Declare it explicitly … or rename one of the two." It said nothing about the retirement or what holders lose.
- **Cadence.** Lazy: it fires on the first resolution that meets an undeclared pair, never at boot. It fires once per position NAME per plugin instance (`nameFoldWarned`). That means not per holder and not per organization, because the key is the name alone. A restart reports again.
- **Consumers of the payload.** None beyond the log line. `git grep position_name_fold_grant` finds only the pin and docblock/CHANGELOG prose. The core logger (`packages/core/src/logger.ts` `write`) spreads `meta` into the JSON line, so the new field arrives in the log as a top-level key beside `event`. No new channel, endpoint or gate is added.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-name-fold-warning.test.ts`, 29 cases (28 before):

- **MUST FIRE, for the census's two cross_scope folds** (`sales_rep`, `sales_manager`, each bound to `crm_sales_user`): the payload is exactly `{ event, position, permissionSet, removedIn: 'next_major' }`, and ⛔ the holder still resolves the same-name set.
- **New: the payload as data.** The exact key set is `event`, `permissionSet`, `position` and `removedIn`, so a renamed legacy field fails as loudly as a missing retirement field.
- **The text** pins clauses ① ② ③ above, no `sys_position_permission_set`, and no `#` followed by a digit.
- **Once per position:** three distinct contexts give one report, and each request still resolves `sales_rep`.
- **MUST NOT FIRE (unchanged cases):** the 7 inert positions, the `org_admin` near-miss, the 13 declared bindings, a declared pair (`permissions: ['sales_rep', …]`, the shape hotcrm#2200 produces), a baseline-named position, and no positions.

**Ablations**, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, run against the warning file. For each one the tool's own evidence reads `ok mutation landed` and `ok restored: blob == HEAD (5db0a1f3c00a) and git diff HEAD is empty`. The plugin's tests import `./security-plugin.js` from `src`, so no `dist/` leg applies.

| leg | mutation (forbidden behaviour put back) | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | drop `removedIn` from the payload | 4 (both MUST FIRE, payload keys, once) |
| A2 | put back the 17.x "in force and ungoverned" wording instead of the retirement sentence | 1 (text) |
| A3 | a tracker id in the string | 1 (text) |
| A4 | stop treating explicitly requested sets as declared | 1 (declared pair) |
| A5 | stop treating baseline names as declared | 1 (baseline) |
| A6 | drop the once-per-position dedupe | 1 (once) |
| A7 | predicate "is this position bound to anything?" | 2 (both bound-to-another-set folds) |
| A8 | remove the position-name request (the 19.0 removal early) | 5 (every MUST FIRE case) |
| A9 | keep the warning but drop the undeclared same-name set after it (the refusal shipped early) | 4, each on the grant assertion: `expected [ 'crm_sales_user', 'member_default' ] to deeply equal [ …(3) ]` and `expected [ 'member_default' ] to include 'sales_rep'` |

A9's first attempt was a no-op: its replacement contained the anchor, and the tool refused with "the anchor count moved 1 -> 1" and restored. The leg was re-run with a replacement that does not contain the anchor. The table reports the second run.

**Suite and typecheck**, at `63246cedf` (the merge of `origin/main` that followed touched only `plugin-approvals`, outside this package's dependency and devDependency closure):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 197 files passed, 4078 tests passed, 45 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security run typecheck` (tsc, the scripts project and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0, with `0 file(s) / 0 error(s) / 0 pinned signature(s)` in `test-typecheck-debt.json`. The test file is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFilesOnly`: 1).

## Gates

These were run locally at `e41097d23`, the head this PR opens on, from the `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derivation at that head: 69 commands, the same 69 the PM's reading at `6440cf163` listed. Each exit code was captured before any pipe.

- **67 exit 0.** Among them: `check:doc-authoring` (sibling-package prose ids hold the empty baseline), `check:nul-bytes`, `check:position-name-fold-loaders` and its `--self-test`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:changeset-no-major` and `check:adr-0087-registration` (both `--base origin/main`), `check:empty-changeset`, `check:published-files`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:type-check-coverage` and `check:type-check-debt`.
- **2 exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: NOT MEASURED locally.** `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:i18n` read every package's `dist/`. This worktree built only `plugin-security` and its dependency closure. CI's fresh build runs both.
- **Reconciliation.** `dispatch-gates --ran` with the exit-coded record: "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 67 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- **Roster gates with a roster beside this diff,** read rather than trusted silent: `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`, all exit 0.
- **Left to CI:** the rest of the farm (`pnpm lint`, the type-check lanes, Test Core, Build Core).

## Acceptance notes

- **Per-name cadence across organizations (observation, not filed).** `nameFoldWarned` keys on the position name alone and the payload names no organization. On a multi-organization deployment, an undeclared pair `P` in a second organization is not reported until restart once the first organization's `P` has warned. This is not reproduced through a public door; it is a source reading. Carrier: #24757's 19.0 half, which removes the warning.
- **Lazy firing (observation).** The warning speaks only when a holder of `P` makes a request. A deployment where no such request has happened since boot has not been told. The readings report on the card noted that a boot-time pass over the registry would be the cheaper place for this. That would be a new trigger, outside this dispatch's "keep the trigger conditions". Carrier: #24757's 19.0 half.
- **Stale cross-reference outside the claimed regions.** The `nameFoldWarned` docblock links `reportNameFoldCollision` (singular), which names no member. It is outside this claim's file surface, so it is left as it is.
- **Explain line.** 「甲」 lists "an explain line" among the loud-half forms. Triage's derivation for this card names only the warning, and `explain-engine.ts` is fenced out of this claim, so this PR ships the warning and its reported event.
